name: ImoTsuyo: Si es por mi hermana menor, seré más fuerte.
source:
After her mother's death, Hana Aochi went into a deep shock leaving her expressionless, does not laugh or cry. But keep saying and doing what she want as she was before. Saigo, her older brother, has been taking care of her ever since. He wants to get his younger sister back to normal, but it won't be an easy task.

[From [url=https://otaku-argento.itch.io/imo-tsuyo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
母亲去世后，青池花陷入了深深的震惊中，面无表情，不笑也不哭。但还是像以前一样，继续说她想做的事，做她想做的事。从那时起，她的哥哥西乡就一直照顾她。他想让妹妹恢复正常，但这并不是一件容易的事。

[来自[url=https://otaku-argento.itch.io/imo-tsuyo]Itch.io[/url]]
